title: Measured three-page overview completion
failure_signature: A content-complete overview remains below the declared 1,000-word three-page-equivalent floor.
trigger_preconditions: The exact staged document review reports an overview below 1,000 words.
candidate_workaround: Add only missing architectural and rollback explanation, then rerun the staged document check.
recurrence_guard: Measure the overview after final sections are generated and before commit.
rollback: Retain the short overview result and remove any filler that does not improve the handoff.
scope_boundary: Overview completeness only; word count does not establish scientific or authority quality.
